description:
The U. S. Army Corps of Engineers is seeking to lease approximately 4,698 gross square feet of existing
Class A or B retail space, in the Harlingen area specifically in zip code 78552. The ideal space would
fit the following: building specifications in compliance with all federal, state and local ordinances;
force protection standards incompliance with Department of Defense's Unified Facility Criteria;
outfitted with either designated or open parking. An initial five year lease is intended. Space must be
ready for occupancy by 1 September 2026.
Expressions of interest should include the following:
-Building name and address
-Floor plan drawing
-Digital photo of street view of property -Area (BOMA rentable square feet &
BOMA usable square feet)
-Rental rate per square foot rentable space Common area factor (s) for available space, if applicable
interested parties may contact: Will Johnston at U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, ATTN: CESWF-RE-A
(Johnston), 819 Taylor Street, Rm 2A06, Fort Worth, TX 76102-0300; 
or
William.B.Johnston@usace.army.mil, no later than 1 September 2026. NOTE: this is a request for
information only, not a solicitation for offers. Note: To protect against computer viruses, email
programs may prevent sending or receiving certain types of file attachments. Check your e-mail.
